title: Act enacted with expanded provincial constitutional framework
detail: The new law reconfigured legislative powers and provincial governance, redefining how political authority could be contested in Bengal.

title: Party strategy and coalition calculations shift
detail: Political blocs adjusted organization, candidate strategy, and bargaining positions under the new constitutional rules.

title: Framework leads into the 1937 Bengal election
detail: The Act's provisions shaped the institutional conditions of Bengal's first major provincial election under expanded autonomy.
